svg.title: Drumlin: stoss and lee ends, and a drumlin swarm
svg.desc: A glacier moving over the land drops boulder clay where it slows or is overloaded and moulds it into a streamlined mound; after the ice melts the drumlin has a steep stoss end facing the oncoming ice and a gentle, tapered lee end, and drumlins lie in swarms all lined up with the ice flow, as in the drowned drumlins of Clew Bay.

text.tspan: at the base of the ice
All lined up with the ice flow
